name: alpaca-trading
description: HFT-style day-trading toolkit for Alpaca Markets — explosive stock scanners (/scan, /gaps, /morning_scanner) plus the enhanced Alpaca MCP server with ~120 tools for streaming quotes, peak/trough analysis, support/resistance levels, order placement, and position monitoring. Requires APCA_API_KEY_ID and APCA_API_SECRET_KEY in the environment.
